personal-statement: DevOps/Platform Engineer, building tools and automations for other engineers at a 150-person MSP to streamline processes and make work easier.

work.name: Endsight
highlights: Designing and building tools (MCPs, webapps) and integrations around numerous APIs using Python and React with thorough tracing and observability, deployed to Azure with GitHub Actions
Integrating Entra and vendor platforms (Domotz, MySonicWall, Liongard) for complete user provisioning/deprovisioning across third-party apps (4 hours saved per onboarding)
Automating tickets for manual drift correction across hundreds of client machines/environments (1-3 hours saved per campaign)
Coordinating and planning automation efforts across departments and teams, gathering requirements and constraints

work.name: Flextechs
highlights: Leading HIPAA and PCI compliance audits, and implementing appropriate security and technical controls in response
Assisting recovery efforts after ransomware attacks and ensuring continuity with backups
Interfacing with clients on strategy and technical issues

work.name: IP Services
highlights: Managing client firewalls and servers inside a colo, front-line helpdesk, and assisting senior engineers with larger projects

personal_projects.name: Spotiplex
personal_projects.description: Open-source Python script/docker container to sync Spotify playlists to a Plex server
highlights: Learned about connecting multiple APIs together
Gained experience translating different data structures and schemas
Learned about building docker images and deploying containers
Increased experience with DevEx/development practices

personal_projects.name: chloemathews.net
highlights: Built out mock terminal interface and experimented with state in React
Expanding Tailwind knowledge and experience
Working with Vercel, then Netlify to learn about serverless deployments and SaaS platforms
Building out resume in JSON format and generating PDF from it
Deepening knowledge of React/TypeScript

work_projects.name: Alert Overload
work_projects.description: Effort to tune and re-evaluate alerts in various systems
highlights: Building dashboards in Streamlit to pull data from our PSA, SNMP monitoring tools, and backup alerting
Reviewing dashboards and data with stakeholders and engineers to prioritize resolution and severity tagging
Working with monitoring vendor to understand best practices and configuration, and passing this knowledge on to internal team members
Eventually obtained a 60% reduction in ticket volume, with positive impact to service delivery due to better focus and prioritization

work_projects.name: User Manager
work_projects.description: Web app and backend API to support automation user onboardings and offboardings
highlights: Initially built as a CLI app using Typer and Python to automate simple AD and Entra tasks like department assignments
Converted to a Flask app for more comprehensive one off automations, and beginning to integrate third party vendor APIs
Improved the app further by converting backend to FastAPI, and frontend to React, and integrating with more APIs
Added full process tracking for account provisioning status across external and internal systems as well as generating projects in the PSA
Integrated idempotent resumability for failed jobs
Fully automated process with auto trigger based on Workday synchronization to Entra

work_projects.name: Proactive Work Campaigns
work_projects.description: Automation app to create bulk tickets for devices outside of compliance/matching conditions
highlights: Initially built in Streamlit, with a MySonicWall cloud integration for generating tickets to schedule and patch vulnerable firewalls
Expanded scope to Liongard Metrics based campaigns and NinjaRMM device campaigns
Integrated data from MySonicwall, ITGlue, ConnectWise, and Logicmonitor to get comprehensive overviews on which firewalls were missing from systems
Migrated from Streamlit to FastAPI backend and React frontend while preserving functionality and maintaining project continuity

work_projects.name: Migrate multiple backends to FastAPI
work_projects.description: Synthesized multiple apps on various frameworks into a single unified FastAPI app
highlights: Planned and implemented the migration of 2 Flask apps, a Streamlit app and an existing FastAPI backend
Implemented robust testing at each stage and migrated each app in sequence, validating it was production ready
Optimized old logic and fixed architectural issues in old code without compromising functionality
Reduced API client and logic duplication across apps to a central source of truth
Implemented RBAC and API permissions

work_projects.name: Migrate multiple frontends to a React SPA
work_projects.description: Synthesized multiple apps on various frameworks into a single unified React app
highlights: Planned and implemented the migration of 2 Flask apps and a Streamlit app
Migrated each app's functionality piecemeal until feature parity was reached, communicating status to engineers and team members
Optimized old logic and fixed architectural issues in old code without compromising functionality
Implemented msal-react and per role rendering and routing
Integrated a FastAPI backend with shared authentication and token validation

work_projects.name: Migrate on-prem docker environment to Azure
work_projects.description: Alongside the rewrites of frontends and backends, deployed the new applications to Azure
highlights: Planned and implemented the migration of deployment, security and networking processes to an Azure first pattern
Worked with GitHub Actions and Azure Container Apps to set up automatic deployments to production/staging environments
Implemented CI/CD pipelines to test, lint and build code
Defined Azure networking and database connectivity for security and management

work_projects.name: Build MCP to interact with internal tools
work_projects.description: Built internal MCP to interface with Service Catalog and on-call calendars
highlights: Wrote and deployed an internal MCP for a Service Catalog, to improve information distribution
Integrated a separate MCP for on-call interfacing, utilizing the same container via a FastAPI router
Implemented RBAC inherited from the backend API utilizing OAuth/MSAL

work_projects.name: Built internal tool to manage on-call shifts and scheduling
work_projects.description: Wrote internal tool to display and manage on-call shifts
highlights: Initially built for internal NOC use, started as a simple data display tool
Once migrated to a FastAPI backend, integrated automatic rotation based schedule generation
Tool includes the ability to swap shifts dynamically without affecting the larger rotation, and implement minute by minute overrides for short coverage bands

Recently upgraded to support the wider Support on-call system, automatically placing and updating entries on a shared calendar, as well as setting up call forwarding within 30 seconds of a shift change
With the support rotation inclusion, schedule generation takes 1 hour versus the previous 4+, and automatic call forwarding rules save 30-60 minutes every week
